memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's batch-gate-pending deferral is enforced mechanically, not just advisory: when a non-stale specs/.orchestration/batch-gate-pending-{session_id}.json marker exists for the current session, an UNFILTERED verify-deploy.sh invocation refuses outright with a literal 'DEFERRED' message naming --only-gate/--gate8-touched (scoped-now) or --override-batch-gate-deferral (reserved for the batch-gate stage's own discharger) as the only two ways forward. A confirmatory implementation dispatch inside a multi-task batch should quote this exact refusal verbatim as positive evidence that the deferral is live, not drift -- rather than treating the refusal as a blocker to work around.

deploy-headless.sh's own inline verification pass supplies --skip-slow --override-batch-gate-deferral to itself, so running deploy-headless.sh inside a batch whose own gate stage has a pending deferral marker does not get misreported as drift or conflated with the batch-gate stage's own eventual full run -- the deploy's self-check and the batch's deferred full sweep are two independently-tracked checks that can both be green without duplicating work.

sapience_notes.subject: lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua remove_tracked
sapience_notes.value: remove_tracked's three tracked-entry types (new_array, new_object, new_value) were originally one branch doing unconditional wholesale t[key] = nil. For an object-shaped merge target (.mcp.json's mcpServers map), the first extension to populate that key is tracked as new_object, so wholesale removal deleted the entire object including any hand-written sibling key living inside it. The fix (commit 3c7f91a92) split new_object into its own branch recursing into info.children (mirroring the existing merged branch) and only pruning the object once empty, with a defensive no-children fallback. new_array/new_value correctly keep unconditional removal since a scalar or freshly-created array has no nested tracked structure a sibling could hide in.

sapience_notes.subject: test-mcp-merge-target.sh Assertions C and E
sapience_notes.value: one fault, not two: both exercise the identical tracked record (mcpServers -> mcpfixture-server) through remove_tracked's new_object arm. Assertion C observes survival immediately post-regenerate (a forced reload's retract-then-remerge round trip); Assertion E observes survival one step further, post-unload. Same code path, same tracked record, two observation points in one sequence.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-deploy.sh batch-gate deferral mechanism
sapience_notes.value: when a non-stale specs/.orchestration/batch-gate-pending-{session_id}.json marker exists, an unfiltered verify-deploy.sh invocation refuses with a literal DEFERRED message rather than running the full gate set, directing the caller to --only-gate/--gate8-touched for a scoped check now or --override-batch-gate-deferral reserved for the batch-gate stage's own discharger. This prevents the full 42-gate battery from running once per concurrent dispatch inside a multi-task /orchestrate batch instead of once per batch.

sapience_notes.subject: task 645 description staleness
sapience_notes.value: a task description's 'remaining scope' framing (seven Gate 8 findings, one substantive defect remaining) had already gone stale by the time the implementation dispatch began -- the named defect was fixed by a commit postdating the description's own last revision. A confirmatory dispatch correctly re-verified every carried figure live (suite pass/fail counts, known-failures.txt row count, git-clean status, live code presence) rather than trusting the description or even the prior plan/report at face value, and all matched.

sapience_notes.subject: task 645 source-store edit-target line
sapience_notes.value: the task description declared 'SOURCE STORE IS THE EDIT TARGET: agent-system/extensions/core/**', but the actual defect and its already-landed fix lived in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua and init.lua (primary Neovim plugin code, never mirrored under agent-system/) plus a contract-doc update under agent-system/extensions/nvim/ (a different extension than core). Only the unchanged test file lived under agent-system/extensions/core/. A description's declared edit-target line can be wrong for a specific defect even when correct for the task's general domain.
